lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection with a slight increase in inter-line distance towards the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular bifurcation is visible on the 9th vertical line (counting from the anterior) where the line splits into two distinct segments near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: One abbreviated line segment is present between the 5th and 6th primary lines in the ventral-mid region. The 10th posterior line is significantly shorter, terminating before reaching the mid-height of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 high-contrast ovoid spots is located on the posterior haunch, characterized by a higher spatial density relative to the vertical line structures.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper hind limb align vertically to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast white horizontal bands on the lower limbs (carpus and tarsus regions) and a dark, prominent dorsal ridge of hair along the spine.
